article_title: 5cardsgame, innovative comprehensive integrative puzzle to enhance clinical reasoning in surgical technologist students: a pre-experimental study.

(2025). 5cardsgame, innovative comprehensive integrative puzzle to enhance clinical reasoning in surgical technologist students: a pre-experimental study. BMC Medical Education. https://doi.org/10.1186/s12909-025-07057-2
title: 5CardsGame: a gamified modified Comprehensive Integrative Puzzle with five color-coded card sets for surgical procedures
description: The 5CardsGame is a modified Comprehensive Integrative Puzzle (CIP) built on script theory and gamification principles to assess and improve clinical reasoning. A panel selected five surgical procedures, and for each, five sets of color-coded cards were created: "Green: Preoperative care. Pink: Anatomy and surgical technique. White: Intraoperative care and instruments. Purple: Postoperative care. Yellow: Surgical complications." Players arrange five cards per scenario like puzzle pieces; points are awarded based on accuracy and speed with immediate feedback after each round.
requirements: Participants must have completed courses on principles and techniques of circular and scrub nursing, surgical technology, and operating room tools and equipment
An expert-validated checklist scoring accuracy (0 to 5 points per scenario) and completion time is needed for evaluation
constraints: The game covers five surgical procedures and, per the authors, "may not encompass all the complexities and variations encountered in real-world surgical settings"
target_learning_goals: integration of preoperative, anatomical, intraoperative, postoperative and complication knowledge into surgical procedure scripts
examples: In each round, six students participated simultaneously and arranged five cards per scenario stuck on the table, over a six-week period with three biweekly assessments
